settled-x402 0.2.1: check x402 endpoints against Settled before paying

Usage:
  npx settled-x402 check <url> [--network <name>] [--post] [--json] [--pass <token>]
      Read the endpoint's 402 quote (nothing is paid) and ask Settled about it.
      --network picks the option you would pay on (default: the network Settled has on record).
      Exit code: 0 pay, 2 caution, 3 avoid, 4 unknown, 1 usage or internal error.
  npx settled-x402 mcp [--pass <token>]
      Run Settled's MCP server over stdio, for Claude Desktop, Cursor and other stdio clients.
  npx settled-x402 --version

Environment: SETTLED_PASS (a Settled day pass), SETTLED_BASE_URL, SETTLED_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1.
Docs: https://settled.tools/for-agents
